answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the river is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the relic of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the quartz behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 19s03.
